notes.title: Indie platformer with 96% Steam rating gets first update in two years
notes.content:
How do you make a platform game without jumping? That's the question legendary indie game developer Terry Cavanagh asks in VVVVVV, the iconic gravity-flipping platformer. Boasting a very deserved, 'overwhelmingly positive' 96% Steam rating, this classic retro-styled adventure just got its first update in two years with the launch of VVVVVV version 2.4, which brings the game to Steam Deck verified status along with localization upgrades and a wealth of other tweaks.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Youtube have rejected Terry Cavanagh's copyright appeal on his own game
Super Hexagon coming to PC

tags.feature: VVVVVV version 2.4, which brings the game to Steam Deck verified status along with localization upgrades and a wealth of other tweaks.

notes.title: VVVVVV 2.4 out now!
notes.content:
Wait, a new VVVVVV update??? It's true! Two years after our last major update, and 14 years since the game's original release, we're back again with version 2.4!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949770/91ec53bbbfc234d10fbdbb16eefaa27388d69abe.png[/img]
(Art by Cheep, thanks again!)

Today's update is focused on localisation. VVVVVV has been professionally translated into 21 new languages for the first time! The full list of new languages is:

 - Catalan
 - Arabic
 - Welsh
 - German
 - Esperanto
 - Spanish
 - French
 - Irish
 - Italian
 - Japanese
 - Korean
 - Dutch
 - Polish
 - Brazilian Portuguese
 - European Portuguese
 - Russian
 - Silesian
 - Turkish
 - Ukrainian
 - Chinese (Simplified)
 - Chinese (Traditional)

This update also brings the game up to Steam Deck verified status, as well as featuring a host of bug fixes and performance improvements. You can read the full changelog on [url=https://vsix.dev/wiki/Version_2.4]the vsix wiki here[/url].

None of this would be possible without the many contributors to the game's source code on github; in particular I want to give a big thanks to Dav999, who led the localisation project for this update. I also want to thank Misa Kai, Reese, Ally, Moth, and everyone else who contributes to keeping VVVVVV alive in ways big and small - I love this game, and I couldn't do this without you <3 - Terry

notes.title: Classic platformer VVVVVV just received its first update in 7 years
notes.content:
Back in April, we reported that classic platformer VVVVVV was about to get its first update in seven years. Now I can report: classic platformer VVVVVV has now received its first update in seven years.

The changelog is huge, but its key additions are 60FPS support, new graphical options, and hundreds of bug fixes.

Read more

notes.title: VVVVVV 2.3 out now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I am super proud to announce VVVVVV 2.3, the first major update to the game in seven years!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949770/6fd3b53f6963bf0faca25d15452630b21663754a.png[/img]
(Adorable fan art by Cheep! Check out more of their work [url=https://twitter.com/CheepThePeanut]on Twitter[/url]!)

This release was made possible as a direct result of making the game's source code available last year, and accepting contributions from the community. It's the result of [i]nearly 2000 commits[/i] to the codebase, fixing hundreds of small bugs and making the game run at its best on modern computers. A really big thanks to all of our contributors for helping to make this happen - [i]especially[/i] Ethan Lee and [i]especially especially[/i] InfoTeddy, who contributed the vast majority of the fixes to this version.

I'll link the complete changelog below, but the highlights are:
[list][*]60+ FPS support
[*]Improved graphical options
[*]New features in the editor
[*]Hundreds of bug fixes
[/list]
[url=https://vsix.dev/wiki/Version_2.3]For the complete change log, see here![/url] Enjoy the update!
